answer: A quiet whisper can still carry weight if the door only opens slowly: new identities pay a small entry fee and must wait through an aging period before they can earn, like a lotus that will not bloom before its season. The queue is carved in marble, no shortcut and no fast lane. A Sybil farmer who wants a thousand working fakes must pay a thousand fees and keep a thousand accounts waiting in line, while an honest agent pays once and simply outlasts the queue.
